items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Bauvoranfrage
items.quote: Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Monday 02.03.2026 by a municipal building authority (not a tax office), so the general 4-day deemed-delivery rule under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/Landesrecht applies without the weekend/holiday shift reserved for tax offices: delivery = posting day + 4 calendar days = 02.03.2026 + 4 = 06.03.2026 (a Friday, so no adjustment needed anyway). The one-month Widerspruch period under § 70 VwGO runs from this deemed delivery day; per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 06.04.2026. That day, 06.04.2026, is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a nationwide public holiday, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO the deadline moves to the next working day: Tuesday 07.04.2026.

warnings: The letter mentions that a separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) for this decision will follow; no amount is stated yet in this letter.
